summary: Cas, the narrator, calls his hacker associate Checker after an explosion that collapsed a building on Arthur, who is now apparently cooperating with authorities. Checker reports NSA agents in his house questioning him about Professor Sonya's case. Cas is bitter about Arthur, dismisses Checker's concern, and directs him to set up a meeting trap for the Lancer, with the goal of rescuing the professor. The excerpt is an unfinished installment of the novel's Book 6.
one_line: Cas phones Checker after an explosion, learns NSA agents are in Checker's house, and orders a trap to lure the Lancer.
key_facts: Cas called Checker while jacking another car, once his hearing had mostly returned after an explosion.
Checker said NSA agents were in his house and that he was whispering because his worst nightmare had come to pass.
Checker said the agents were interested only in what he knew about Professor Sonya's case.
Cas told Checker that Arthur had a building fall on him and was fine.
Cas said Arthur was running to the authorities, naming the NSA, Homeland Security, or whoever was running the operation.
Checker said he thought it was a joint operation, and that the NSA doesn't have field agents.
Cas said someone in the mess really likes playing with explosives and that they almost blew him up too.
Cas asked Checker whether he had planted the evidence for the Lancer yet, and Checker said yes, mostly.
Cas instructed Checker to set up a meeting so the Lancer thinks Cas is taking a meeting and can track him down at a location with no bystanders.
Cas asked Checker to text him the location.
Cas said they would kick the case in the balls and get Professor Sonya back.
